scales.name: Miyako-bushi
scales.context_note: A constructed octave species: two identical 500-cent tetrachords separated by a 200-cent step. Western semitone notation is a mathematical encoding, not measured intonation. Nuclear tones and melodic functions are not represented by the interval ring. Reference pitch is not a claim of a unique tonic.
